docs/extensions.md: The order is: the coding tools of pi-action (`coding-tools`) first, then pi-action's `pi-action-context` (the `project_context` section, see [The system prompt](prompts.md#the-system-prompt)), then its built-in extension `pi-action` (the [`available_skills`](skills.md#the-system-prompt) section), then the extensions in the order of the `extensions` input. Extensions cannot use the names `coding-tools`, `pi-action-context`, and `pi-action`. pi-durable applies the wraps of all extensions in this order. Thus, the last wrap wins.
